scope: All24 current-policy parser26 fixed baseline games, no fresh holdout outcomes. Only legal playable-card candidates with an effect type containing income are observed; this includes immediate-only icon effects and excludes triggered income without a playQueue income effect. It is not an exhaustive income-card catalog. Deduplicate by game/player/physical card instance. A positive card score need not beat another action; chosen action and all visible observations are retained. Actual income-track increases counted independently from events and never inferred from effect names. No future income/score counterfactual is claimed.
